`*-live.json` are real recordings made on 2026-10-28 (Met object and v1.1 search, Cleveland artwork and
search, Commons imageinfo). Re-record with `node tools/record_fixtures.mjs <url> <file>`.

The other files are hand-written to each museum's documented response shape, with invented works, so no
test depends on a real museum's wording. AIC (Cloudflare challenge), Smithsonian and Rijksmuseum (no key) could not
be recorded yet; replace theirs when they can.
